name: To Go Plate
body:
Can we please get a box for this?

Prerequisite(s): 1st-level culinarian.

Benefit(s): When you prepare meals for the day, you can also create up to 2 of those meals as to go plates. Each to go plate can be given to an ally who can set it out as a full-round action. The meal’s duration doesn’t begin until set out in this way, but the meals expire in 24 hours if not consumed.
